parts.title: Python shell
responsibilities: The command line entry: read the options, find the repository and the configuration.
Locate the core binary and launch it as a process with one typed request.
Check the frame that the core returns against its schema and show it as text, JSON or a report file.
Read and write the baseline files that the user names.
forbidden_responsibilities: Deciding any rule, status or verdict: the core decides, the shell only shows.
Reading source files to collect facts.
provides: The archkeel command: validate, report and skill install.

parts.title: Rust core
responsibilities: Collect the facts of the source files with the collector of each language.
Build the model of the facts, evaluate each rule of the contract and decide the status.
Write the one frame of the run and the report page that show the decision.
forbidden_responsibilities: Terminal output, option parsing and packaging: the shell owns them.
Trusting a status, a digest or a reply that a caller gives.
provides: The core frame protocol archkeel-core-frame-1: one frame for each request, with the schema schema/archkeel-core-frame-1.schema.json.
